## Type of change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Performance improvement

## PR Checklist
- [ ] **Testing Done**: I have performed self-testing and added/updated tests where necessary.
- [ ] **Tests Pass**: All automated tests (`python -m pytest tests/`) are passing.
- [ ] **Coverage**: Test coverage is maintained or improved (Target: >80% for production-ready code).
- [ ] **Documentation Updated**: README, docs/, or inline docstrings have been updated.
- [ ] **Backward Compatibility**: I have verified that this change does not break existing functionality.
- [ ] **Security Review**: No secrets are exposed, and dependencies have been audited if added.
- [ ] **Style**: Code follows repository linting and formatting standards (Ruff/Black).
